facts.fact: The joint ICT sector review lists the ICT Sector Strategic Plan as covering 2018-2024; no date for the stated period is given, so the review's publication date 2023-10-26 is used.

The ICT Sector Working Group's backward-looking review for 2022/23 has a section on progress against 2022/23 targets, NST1, the SSP and SDGs, and a section on lessons learned from NST1 and SSP implementation; the retained passages give no figures, so the review's publication date 2023-10-26 is used.
